knownOrdinaryInventoryClosure: All nine concrete ordinaryRemaining entries from work/roads-bridges/remaining-inventory.json are included through roads-addendum, town-props-addendum and outdoor-props-addendum. That original report is a pre-addendum snapshot.
limits: This is not a claim that every decorative map tile or unique prop in every location/event has been inventoried or redrawn.

Selected shared map placements were traced across 15 standard maps. Desert, Railroad, special/festival maps and Town makeover variants remain outside comprehensive map coverage. The separate native island suspension bridge is included.
Vehicles, building facades, unique event decorations and unscanned location-specific props are outside this bounded batch. Native flame, mail-notification and garbage-particle effects remain in use.

Verification uses isolated native draw fixtures, item source/rotation bounds, static map reconstructions and title-screen loading. No farm save, bridge repair quest, crafting, garbage interaction or full location playthrough is performed.
